name: Nested Segments
description: You are given n segments on a line. There are no ends of some segments that coincide. For each segment find the number of segments it contains.
input_specification: The first line contains a single integer n ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10 5 ) — the number of segments on a line. Each of the next n lines contains two integers l i and r i ( - 10 9 ≤ l i < r i ≤ 10 9 ) — the coordinates of the left and the right ends of the i -th segment. It is guaranteed that there are no ends of some segments that coincide.
output_specification: Print n lines. The j -th of them should contain the only integer a j — the number of segments contained in the j -th segment.
approach_summary: Build a Segment Tree over the array. Implement point update and associative range query operations in O(log N) time per query.
